title: Any other business
old_caption: Capricorn put feelings on the agenda as item three, then admitted they answered I love you with noted. The fix took five minutes and got minuted. Which sign would reply noted?

title: Wrong chat
old_caption: Aries announced the secret gift exchange pick in the group chat. Virgo saw nothing, apparently. The best gift idea came from one question: what did you notice? Who in your chat can't keep a secret?

title: The poll
old_caption: Cancer made a dinner poll and every vote landed somewhere different. Gemini voted three times. Pick the night most can do, save a seat on a screen for the rest. Who runs the polls in your chat?

title: Pinned (again)
old_caption: Leo pinned their own message again, then spiraled over one soup joke. Virgo: ask what makes them laugh. Now the pinned message is their date's goose story. Which sign pins their own compliments?

title: The coat room
old_caption: Libra hosted the party, then hid in the coat room texting the chat. Going back out with some water and a smile paid off: a seat with their name on a napkin. Ever hidden at your own party?

title: Gift reveals
old_caption: Gift exchange reveals: Taurus got two pairs of socks and wore both. Aquarius got a lamp shaped like Leo. Thank them for the thought, it's real. What's the funniest gift your chat has swapped?

title: New season, new me
old_caption: It's Capricorn season and Capricorn announced feelings. Then a résumé for meeting the partner's friends. Swapped for one question about their dog: three new friends. Who in your chat brings a résumé?

title: Sixty photos
old_caption: Sag came home from the surprise trip with sixty photos and plans for the next one. Their person was tired. Turns out blanket, soup and one film is also a trip. Which sign plans the next trip on the way home?

title: Three threads
old_caption: Three questions at once, one Gemini, one bubble: chocolate chip, yes, tell them. Scorpio did, and they like them back. Gemini is taking full credit. Who in your chat is accidentally wise?

title: Forwarded
old_caption: Pisces forwarded their date's voice note, too emotional to hear it twice. Scorpio played it: a made-up song that rhymes Pisces with nice is. Saying what it meant took one second. Who sends the voice notes?
